high_impact.wind_control: Compare C0-C2 fits capped at 25 epochs with the same trainer, inner cuts and seed. If a model is competitive, repeat seeds 1 and 2 before promotion.
high_impact.temporal_gate: Do not evaluate positive offsets on official data without a compatible approved protocol and issue-time availability evidence. Valid-time timestamps alone are insufficient.
high_impact.pivot: Short tendencies were more useful than long concatenation, but DCT and nonlinear RBF designs trailed R5. Prefer causal spatial advection or coarse-grid spectral/local fusion over more lag and kernel sweeps.

next_matched_comparisons.criterion: The first UV control substantially trails the incumbent in C0 and its inner error is still falling. Test whether training-only spatial diurnal climatology or broader context improves U/V; compare each physics pair at fixed capacity.
Assess whether magnitude and calm-weighted circular supervision help after changes to inputs, especially at train-defined high speeds.
Compare structure, stress-test strong winds with geographic stratification, reject tradeoffs that worsen the pooled score.

promotion: Confirm promising architecture with screening seed 0 plus seeds 1 and 2 under same epoch-selection policy. Publish no unconfirmed finalist. C3 only after A freezes integration.
recovery: Rerun train.agent_b.round6.run with the same options to reuse verified per-fold results; no concurrent B writers. Inspect agent_b/research_state.json. Run report before publishing.
